reduction_methods_legend.simp: simplification via rewrite rules — for conjunctive or standard simplifications

metadata.methodology: Regex-based extraction of `axiom` keyword declarations in Lean 4 syntax. Multi-line declarations captured by extending until blank line, comment, or new declaration keyword. Comments (-- and /- -/) excluded. Classification uses signature heuristics: placeholder if conclusion is True or → True; definitional if equality/iff/existence with concrete terms; schema if type parameters (α β γ : Type) present; primitive otherwise.
metadata.limitations: Classification is heuristic based on signature patterns. Boundary cases may require manual review. Reduction methods are suggestions — actual provability requires Lean compiler verification.
